0.title: Global Action Required Components
0.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize runtime_issue = countIf(source_status != "current"), by: { component } | join [ load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter is_latest == "true" | summarize upgrade_issue = countIf(is_newer_than_running == "true"), by: { component } ], on: { component } | fieldsAdd upgrade_issue = right.upgrade_issue | summarize action_required = countIf(runtime_issue > 0 or upgrade_issue > 0)

1.content:
## SaaS
Admin read order: breaking to plan for -> what is coming -> value -> action -> release link

2.title: SaaS Runtime Source Health
2.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | filter component == "saas" | summarize rows = count(), by: { source_status, source_type, observed_version } | fieldsAdd status_badge = if(source_status == "current", "🟢 current", else: if(source_status == "partial", "🟠 partial", else: if(source_status == "not_configured", "🟠 not configured", else: "🔴 unavailable"))) | sort source_status asc, source_type asc

3.title: SaaS Release Status
3.query:
load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status"
| filter component == "saas"
| fields released_version, release_status, is_latest, is_next_planned, running_version, parsed_breaking_changes, parsed_feature_sections, raw_release_summary, release_notes_url = release_url, fetched_at
| fieldsAdd coming_next = if(is_next_planned == "true", "yes", else: "no"), breaking_now = if(parsed_breaking_changes != "" and parsed_breaking_changes != "-", "⚠ possible", else: "none"), release_link = if(release_notes_url != "" and release_notes_url != "-", concat("[Open release](", release_notes_url, ")"), else: "-"), release_snapshot_raw = if(raw_release_summary != "" and raw_release_summary != "-", raw_release_summary, else: parsed_feature_sections)
| fieldsAdd release_snapshot = if(stringLength(release_snapshot_raw) > 320, concat(substring(release_snapshot_raw, from: 0, to: 320), "..."), else: release_snapshot_raw)
| fields released_version, release_status, is_latest, is_next_planned, running_version, coming_next, breaking_now, release_snapshot, release_link, release_notes_url, fetched_at
| sort is_latest desc, is_next_planned desc, released_version desc

4.title: SaaS Upgrade Queue
4.query:
load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status"
| filter component == "saas" and is_latest == "true" and released_version != "" and released_version != "Not yet published"
| join [
    load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status"
    | filter component == "saas" and is_next_planned == "true"
    | fields component, upcoming_version = released_version, upcoming_breaking = parsed_breaking_changes, upcoming_feature_sections = parsed_feature_sections, upcoming_raw_summary = raw_release_summary
  ], on: { component }
| fields component, running_version, latest_published = released_version, is_newer_than_running, risk_priority, action_hint, breaking_changes_summary, parsed_breaking_changes, parsed_feature_sections, raw_release_summary, release_notes_url = release_url, upcoming_version = right.upcoming_version, upcoming_breaking = right.upcoming_breaking, upcoming_feature_sections = right.upcoming_feature_sections, upcoming_raw_summary = right.upcoming_raw_summary, fetched_at
| fieldsAdd release_link = if(release_notes_url != "" and release_notes_url != "-", concat("[Open release](", release_notes_url, ")"), else: "-"), action = if(is_newer_than_running == "true", "🔴 newer available", else: if(running_version == "" or running_version == "-", "🟠 runtime unknown", else: "🟢 aligned")), action_priority = if(is_newer_than_running == "true", 1, else: if(running_version == "" or running_version == "-", 2, else: 3)), current_breaking = if(parsed_breaking_changes != "" and parsed_breaking_changes != "-", parsed_breaking_changes, else: if(breaking_changes_summary != "" and breaking_changes_summary != "-", breaking_changes_summary, else: "No explicit breaking changes listed")), breaking_now = if(parsed_breaking_changes != "" and parsed_breaking_changes != "-" or contains(lower(breaking_changes_summary), "breaking"), "⚠ review", else: "none"), coming_next = if(upcoming_version != "" and upcoming_version != "-" and upcoming_version != "Not yet published", concat(upcoming_version, if(upcoming_breaking != "" and upcoming_breaking != "-", " (check breaking notes)", else: "")), else: "Not published"), current_summary_raw = if(raw_release_summary != "" and raw_release_summary != "-", raw_release_summary, else: parsed_feature_sections), upcoming_summary_raw = if(upcoming_raw_summary != "" and upcoming_raw_summary != "-", upcoming_raw_summary, else: upcoming_feature_sections), recommended_action_raw = if(action_hint == "" or action_hint == "-", "No immediate action", else: if(contains(lower(action_hint), "runtime version unknown"), "Verify runtime source coverage", else: if(contains(lower(action_hint), "no immediate action required"), "No immediate action", else: action_hint)))
| fieldsAdd current_summary = if(stringLength(current_summary_raw) > 320, concat(substring(current_summary_raw, from: 0, to: 320), "..."), else: current_summary_raw), upcoming_summary = if(stringLength(upcoming_summary_raw) > 320, concat(substring(upcoming_summary_raw, from: 0, to: 320), "..."), else: upcoming_summary_raw), recommended_action = if(stringLength(recommended_action_raw) > 80, concat(substring(recommended_action_raw, from: 0, to: 80), "..."), else: recommended_action_raw)
| fieldsAdd admin_brief_raw = concat("Breaking to plan for: ", current_breaking, " || What is coming: ", upcoming_summary, " || Why this matters: ", current_summary, " || What to do now: ", recommended_action, " || Release: ", release_link)
| fieldsAdd admin_brief = if(stringLength(admin_brief_raw) > 1200, concat(substring(admin_brief_raw, from: 0, to: 1200), "..."), else: admin_brief_raw)
| sort action_priority asc
| fields running_version, latest_published, action, risk_priority, breaking_now, coming_next, current_breaking, recommended_action, admin_brief, release_link, release_notes_url, fetched_at
